1.explanation: Dropdown.js is where the light prop is consumed and used to add the dropdown--light class but is not forwarded into the inner <ListBox> component. ListBox.js is the component that needs to accept a light boolean and apply the “bx--list-box--light” class when light=true. ListBoxPropTypes.js defines which props ListBox accepts – it must declare light as a boolean so the component can receive it. Together these three files must be updated so that the light prop flows from the Dropdown wrapper into ListBox and triggers the correct CSS class on the listbox element.
1.bug_scenario: When you toggle the “light” knob on the React dropdown/listbox story, the outer wrapper correctly gets the “bx--dropdown--light” class but the actual listbox element never receives the “light” prop so it never gets the “bx--list-box--light” class. In the browser you can see a single DIV with role="listbox" whose class is “bx--dropdown bx--dropdown--light bx--list-box” – the missing piece is adding the light variant for the listbox itself.

2.explanation:
• Dropdown.js: this file renders the `<Dropdown>` component and applies the `light` class to the outer wrapper, but it never passes the `light` prop down into the inner `<ListBox>`. Without forwarding `light`, the ListBox component can’t switch its own BEM class.  
• ListBox.js: this component reads a `light` prop and, when true, adds the `bx--list-box--light` modifier class. However, since Dropdown never provides that prop, the code here never runs.  
• ListBoxPropTypes.js: Prop types for the ListBox must include `light: PropTypes.bool` so that the prop is documented and type-checked. Adding it here ensures consistent API and catches omissions in the future.
2.bug_scenario: In the React “Dropdown” story, toggling the “light” knob causes the outer dropdown wrapper to receive the `bx--dropdown--light` class, but the internal `<ListBox>` element never sees the `light` prop and therefore never gets the `bx--list-box--light` class. Visually, the menu dropdown still renders in the dark style even when the story’s light mode is enabled.
